documents.title: Robotics Club - Meeting Notes (Sep 22)
documents.label: public
documents.body:
Robotics Club weekly meeting, September 22.

- Attendance: 14 members.
- The fall build night is confirmed for October 3 in the engineering lab.
- We still need two volunteers to run the welcome table at the involvement fair.
- The coordinator will send the room booking reminder next week.

Action items: finish the drivetrain parts list; post the build-night flyer by Friday.
